name: Skills
why: A skill, from its first line to the thread that uses it
ideal: Each skill follows the authoring rules, is proven by three evals, fires when due and costs few listing tokens.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Extend Claude with skills

steps.name: Write
steps.rule: Names and descriptions follow the authoring rules.

steps.name: Test
steps.rule: Three eval cases prove each skill fired.

steps.name: Fire
steps.rule: A thread uses a matching skill when one is due.

steps.name: Find
steps.rule: A skill is found on the first try.

steps.name: List
steps.rule: The skill listing adds few tokens to a start.
